args.title: Triage issue 4409
args.body:
File: README.md

The running locally steps in README.md mention MinIO as the quickest option for an S3-compatible store, but fail to instruct the user to set S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 (and create the bucket in MinIO first, as noted by maintainer and reporter).

label: docs
file: README.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The running locally steps in README.md mention MinIO as the quickest option for an S3-compatible store, but fail to instruct the user to set S3_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000 (and create the bucket in MinIO first, as noted by maintainer and reporter).
